title: Lineage finding — one column traced to its terminal sources

sources.description: One entry per terminal source. A column with several contributing sources (CASE, COALESCE, UNION branches, arithmetic) has several entries.

source_column.description: empty when source_type is literal or derived-without-column

mapping_rule.description: the full derivation from this source to the target column, composed across hops, as SQL/expression text

mapping_business_rule.description: one plain-English sentence a business analyst can read; no SQL keywords

code_path.description: repo-relative path of the most decisive expression for this source

hops.description: The chain you walked, target-side first. Lets a reviewer replay the trace.

object.description: the object read at this hop (table/temp/CTE/DataFrame)

unresolved_reason.description: set when any branch hit a dead end: what you looked for, where, and why it stopped
